checks.message: Deterministic submission validation passes locally via scripts/self_check_submission.py and scripts/participant_preflight.py: scope limited to the participant proposal directory, manifest SHA-256 hashes verified for every registered asset, and PR-author claim matches the fork path.

SPATIAL_REVIEW PASS (issues=3, all KEY_AREA_PROVISIONAL): provisional site boundary and three provisional key areas are explicitly disclosed as non-official; all areas recomputed in EPSG:4548 with validator union logic; organizer geometry gaps do not block content scoring and recalculation is committed once official geometry is supplied.

VISUAL_PACKAGING PASS (issues=0): static HTML visualization has no external dependencies (no CDN, tiles, scripts, remote fonts, requests, iframes, or forms); five figure pairs are truly bilingual renders from GeoJSON in both Chinese and English; PDFs rebuilt as true-figure editions.

v0.17 proposal includes executive brief table (6 rows), evidence level table (6 categories with what-cannot-be-proved column), 3-option scenario comparison (7-dimension scoring), OSM independent spatial cross-check (7 stations inside boundary, Dazhongsi ~200m outside), 12 scenario cards with seven-field matrix and SYM credential IDs, SYM Symbiosis Credential Schema 1.0 named deliverable, 8 action packages with exit conditions and 3-phase timeline, 5+5 user personas, 3 AI landmarks, 14-metric EPSG:4548 recalculation table with three epistemic subsections, a clause-by-clause taskbook traceability index mapping all 23 mandatory announcement/agent requirements to script-verified real headings, SVG brand logo, generation-and-review method disclosure binding all eight self-check IDs, and comprehensive reference bibliography.
Using PROV-SITE-001 provisional boundary derived from public announcement text. Official boundary must be provided before professional scoring. All area calculations are provisional and disclosed.
Three required key areas (PROV-KEY-001/002/003) are provisional rectangle approximations. Real polygons must be provided by organizers before professional scoring.
Four land-use partitions cover the site boundary fully without overlap. All use standard MNR land-use classification codes (0802/1401/05/0702).
Static HTML visualization generated without external dependencies (no CDN, remote map tiles, external scripts, external fonts, API requests, iframes, or form submissions).
Supplementary evidence inventory retained for traceability; the blocking PROFESSIONAL_EVIDENCE gate above carries the formal four-gate record.

All 14 metrics cross-verified: building_footprint_area_sqm=2,743,531 from 24 building footprints; green_ratio=0.2146 and public_space_ratio=0.1050 recomputed with validator union logic in EPSG:4548; scenario_card_count=12 and action_package_count=8 match proposal.md; all values consistent across all outputs.

12 scenario cards all include manual review checkpoints and human takeover points. No personal trajectory data collection. Algorithm downgrade triggered by 3+ complaints. Night noise limit 55dB. Vulnerable group verification table with accessible pathway alternatives.

All text, geometry, diagrams, PDFs, and HTML assets declared as AI agent OpenSquilla generated. Fonts unified to Noto Sans SC (SIL Open Font License v1.1, commercial use permitted); figures and PDFs re-rendered with this font and registered in the asset manifest. SVG symbiosis-mark.svg uses original geometric composition without corporate trademarks. CASE-* sources registered with URLs and accessed dates.
